ExtremeEventResistance.description:
Agronomic resistance and tolerance metrics to severe abiotic weather shocks:

drought_resistance.description: Resilience against soil moisture deficits and prolonged dry spells

flood_waterlogging_resistance.description: Resilience against root-zone hypoxia, ponding, standing water, and anaerobic saturation

frost_cold_resistance.description: Resilience to sudden late spring frost, early autumn freezes, or harsh overwintering temperatures

extreme_heat_resistance.description: Resilience to canopy scorching, pollen sterilization, and heat shock above 35°C

description:
Unified Ingestion Payload accepted by the Input Parser API.
Encompasses all core agronomic domains:
- Parcel Info (with Soil Type)
- Last couple years harvest/crop info (1-5 flexible)
- Seed / Water / Oil Prices (with Greenhouse need & Extreme Event resistance inside seed data)
- NASA data (Official raw database responses & full dated daily/scene timeseries)
- Long Term Weather Projections (optional)
- Local User Data (with dated in-situ sensor readings & soil type override)
- Elevation Maps

parcel_info.description: 1. Parcel cadastral, geometry, coordinates, and soil type

economic_prices.description: 3. Seed, Water, Oil/Diesel, fertilizer prices, and seed characteristics

seed_data.description: Optional top-level seed data list (can also be provided inside economic_prices.seed_data)
seed_data.title: Seed Data

nasa_data.description: 4. NASA Earth Observations (POWER, GPM, SMAP, OpenET, ECOSTRESS, HLS, etc.)

local_user_data.description: 6. Local in-situ sensor data with date signatures, equipment, soil override, and farm constraints

elevation_maps.description: 7. Elevation, terrain slope, aspect, and waterlogging metrics

title: FullFieldIngestionPayload
